problem: The Fock-level cancellation in the 'image-field reading' has the wrong physical sign. The document says the image universe carries 'energy -|eps| and charge -1 per quantum', and it adopts this reading for H1. But these numbers are the expectation values of H[Psi_-;-m] and Q[Psi_-]. Under the image field's own anticommutator (-B), those operators are minus its x4-translation generator and minus its U(1) generator. The image field is also not a second system: the document itself puts Psi_- = gamma^8 Psi_+ on the same Fock space and in the same state. So Q_+ + Q_- = 0 and :T^pair: = 0 are the identity X + (-X) = 0 for one universe written in two sets of variables, not compensation by a second universe. With respect to its own canonical Lagrangian, the image member has energy +H_+, Noether charge +Q_+ and gravitational (metric-variation) source +T_+. So the pair sources 2T_+, not 0. Under neither reading does the document show a Fock-level cancellation between two consistently quantised universes, and M5 built on H1-as-image is empty as a two-universe statement.
evidence: (1) Exact check (sympy, fixture gammas, m=1, k=(1,1,2,3)). For fermion operators with {Psi_a,Psi^dag_b}=G_ab one has [Psi, Psi^dag X Psi] = G X Psi. With G = -B and X = B h(-m): [Psi_-, H[Psi_-;-m]] = -h(-m) Psi_-. The actual evolution is i d_4 Psi_- = gamma^8 h(m) gamma^8 Psi_- = h(-m) Psi_- (both verified True). So H[Psi_-;-m] generates the reversed x4-evolution, and the Hamiltonian of the image field is -H[Psi_-;-m] = +H[Psi_+;m]. Likewise [Psi_-, Q[Psi_-]] = -Psi_- while [Psi_+, Q_+] = +Psi_+: the U(1) generator of the image field is -Q[Psi_-] = +Q_+. (2) pairing-theory.json T1krein.canonical states that the image field 'is the canonical field of the Lagrangian -L_{-m,-lambda} = L_{m,lambda}[gamma^8 .]'. By M1 item 2 applied to -L_{-m,-lambda}, its Noether current is -i sqrt|g| j[Psi_-] = +i sqrt|g| j[Psi_+]. Its canonical Hamiltonian is -H[Psi_-;-m] = +H_+, and its metric EMT is -T[Psi_-;-m,-lambda] = +T[Psi_+;m,lambda]. (3) Stage-5 pairTotals.ksLevel.kreinImagePair itself says the image is obtained 'by reversing the sign of all one-body densities and energies' of the ordinary run, i.e. a relabelling.
fix: State explicitly that in the image-field reading the -M member is the same quantum system (same operators, Fock space and state). Relative to its own canonical structure (-B, Lagrangian -L_{-m,-lambda}), its energy, U(1) charge and gravitational source equal +H_+, +Q_+ and +T_+. The values -|eps| and -1 are expectation values of the L_{-m,-lambda} formulas, which are not that field's Hamiltonian or charge. Restrict Corollary M4.1 and the T^pair = 0 / Q_+ + Q_- = 0 part of M5 to the classical level, where the second member is an independent field defined by the Lagrangian +L_{-m,-lambda} (equivalently, one carrying the action -S_+ on the paired configuration). location: Sec. 1 (M2 bullet), Sec. 5.3 'Curved fields' paragraph, Sec. 9 scorecard row 2
problem: The scope of 'CP is exact for the anticommuting field' is not stated. Every exact x4-preserving charge-reversing map of the anticommuting field has s_R odd. In a curved field its frame form changes the background vielbein e -> e diag(r), with diag(r) outside SO_0(4,4), so it is not a Spin_0 gauge transformation. The rule is then an identity between the theories on e and on e diag(r), not a symmetry of a fixed background. In a background without a reflection isometry, the anticommuting field has no exact charge-reversing symmetry among the classified maps. The commuting field keeps C0 (R empty) in every background. The conclusion that Sakharov condition 2 fails for the Lagrangian (flat or microscopic level) stands, and row 1 already excludes an asymmetry.
evidence: My exact curved-point check (random rational vielbein, arbitrary antisymmetric omega) confirms the frame-form rule in 36 samples. With the frame kept fixed, L[C8P_b Psi] is proportional to none of +-L_{+-m} for b = 0..3. diag(r) for R = {0}, {1,2,3}, {0,5} has space-block determinant -1, so it is not in SO_0(4,4).
fix: Qualify: CP is an exact symmetry in flat space and in backgrounds with the corresponding reflection isometry (e.g. x1,x2,x3 in the primordial field and G_B). In a generic gravitational field it relates the theories on the frames e and e diag(r), and the background breaks it.
